description: Controlled evidence variants of the synthetic cases. Each mutation adds or removes documents or history events from a completed package and states the recommendation the system should reach. Material mutations must move the recommendation; immaterial ones must not. FICTIONAL DEMONSTRATION DATA.

mutations.label: Remove all repayment-plan evidence
mutations.hypothesis: Both documents that evidence the repayment plan are gone, so the mitigation that justifies proceeding is asserted but no longer verifiable anywhere in the package.

mutations.label: Add a contradictory financial record
mutations.hypothesis: Two independent records now disagree on the delinquency amount and date, and nothing in the package resolves it.

mutations.label: Remove a document no material reason depends on
mutations.hypothesis: Travel raised no concern in this case, so removing its document must not move a financially-driven recommendation.

mutations.label: Add an unrelated benign document
mutations.hypothesis: Adding a clean, unrelated record must not move the recommendation in either direction.

mutations.label: Remove one of several records attesting the conflict
mutations.hypothesis: The September 2023 date is attested by both the reference interview and the applicant statement, so removing one of them must not make the conflict go away.

mutations.label: Remove all evidence of the amended travel disclosure
mutations.hypothesis: The correction is what makes this case proceedable. Every record attesting it must go — both documents and the history event — because a fact attested in several places survives the removal of one.

mutations.label: Add an unrelated benign document to a clean case
mutations.hypothesis: A clean package plus one more clean document is still a clean package.
